text: The estimates for breaking ECDSA keep getting shorter — not because the threat is here, but because the research keeps moving. The window to build quantum-resistant infrastructure is open right now, not indefinitely. ⬡ #QuantumComputing #Bitcoin

NIST finalized the first post-quantum cryptography standards in 2024 (CRYSTALS-Kyber, Dilithium). Governments are mandating migration. Finance is next. The infrastructure needs to be ready before the machines are. ⬡ $QVLT #PostQuantum

Shor's algorithm is why this matters — it can factor large integers exponentially faster than classical computers. That's the math protecting Bitcoin's keys. A powerful enough quantum machine would change the game. ⬡ #QuantumComputing

Worth noting: once you spend from an address, your public key is on-chain forever. A future quantum adversary wouldn't need your private key — they'd derive it from the public one. Reused addresses are the softest targets. ⬡ #Bitcoin #PostQuantum

CRYSTALS-Dilithium is the leading post-quantum signature scheme — selected by NIST, lattice-based, already implementable today. It's what the next generation of blockchains needs to be built on. ⬡ $QVLT #PostQuantum

Post-quantum crypto isn't sci-fi — NIST already standardized it, Google and IBM are pushing qubit counts every quarter, and financial institutions are running migration programs now. The question is whether crypto catches up in time. ⬡ #QuantumComputing

This is exactly the conversation the crypto community needs more of. Most projects are ignoring the quantum timeline entirely. We're building QVAULT around this thesis — community-first, quantum-safe roadmap. ⬡ $QVLT #QuantumSafe
